description: This file is a shell script named 'release.sh' that automates the process of version bumping for software components based on commit history, PR labels, and component metadata. It includes functions for parsing git history, reading and updating YAML metadata, and computing new version numbers. It is a utility script used during release workflows.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves PR number associated with a commit, via PR merge info or GitHub API

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Fetches labels for a given PR from GitHub

methods.name: component_from_path
methods.description: Determines component directory from a file path based on known components

methods.name: is_doc_like_path
methods.description: Checks if a file path is considered documentation or metadata related

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Calculates the next version and generation based on bumps

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates version and generation in component metadata YAML files
